Declarative model specification

pk_spec.Rd

A model is described as data, not as code: structure (number of compartments, route, lag time), inter-individual variability (IIV), omega blocks, inter-occasion variability (IOV), residual error model, covariate relationships, and initial estimates. pk_compile() turns the specification into an nlmixr2 model function.

Usage

pk_spec(
  ncmt = 2,
  route = c("oral", "iv"),
  lag = FALSE,
  iiv = NULL,
  blocks = list(),
  iov = NULL,
  error = c("prop", "add", "comb"),
  covariates = NULL,
  extra_thetas = list(),
  inits = list(),
  custom_fn = NULL
)

Arguments

ncmt

Number of compartments (1 or 2).

route

"oral" (first-order absorption) or "iv".

lag

Include an absorption lag time (oral only)?

iiv

Parameters with IIV. Default: clearance and the central volume.

blocks

List of character vectors; each defines an omega block, e.g. list(c("cl", "v2")).

iov

NULL or a list with param, occasion (column name) and levels, see pk_add_iov().

error

Residual error model: "prop", "add" or "comb".

covariates

Covariate relationships (a tibble, see pk_add_cov()).

extra_thetas

Named list of additional fixed-effect parameters (name = initial value) that are written to the ini block.

inits

Named list with initial estimates (natural scale): structural parameters, prop.sd, add.sd, om (named vector of IIV variances) and om_cov (named vector of block covariances, e.g. c(cl.v2 = 0.01)). Missing entries get defaults.

custom_fn

Escape hatch: a ready-made nlmixr2 model function. When given, it is used as is and the other arguments are ignored (except for bookkeeping), so the editing verbs such as pk_add_iiv() do not apply.

Value

A pk_spec object.

Details

Parameters are named ka, cl, v (one compartment) or v2, q, v3 (two compartments), and tlag. All structural parameters are log-normal: P = exp(lP + covariate terms + eta.P).

Examples

spec <- pk_spec(ncmt = 2, lag = TRUE, iiv = c("ka", "cl", "v2"), error = "prop")
spec
#> <pk_spec>: 2-compartment, oral, lag time
#> IIV: "ka", "cl", and "v2"; blocks: 0; IOV: none
#> Residual error: "prop"
#> Covariates: none
